headline: Rachika Nayar’s Heaven Come Crashing is an instrumental epic of desperate longing
summary: Rachika Nayar's new album, Heaven Come Crashing, features a massive drum and bass sound. This marks a significant departure from her previous percussion-free work. The album is described as an instrumental epic.

headline: Fender’s CEO seems to think your bandmates are just analog AI
summary: Fender CEO Edward Cole stirred controversy by comparing bandmates to 'analog AI.' His comments were made during an interview celebrating the Telecaster's 75th anniversary. These remarks are adding to negative PR for the company amid ongoing AI debates.

headline: Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170
summary: Microsoft is implementing dramatic price increases for Xbox consoles in the EU and UK. Prices will rise by up to €200 or £170, depending on the model. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is among the affected models.

headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight smart calendars are offering discounts of up to $90 for a limited time. This back-to-school sale runs from August 2nd through August 9th. The calendars help families manage busy schedules and responsibilities.

headline: How TCL’s 2026 TV Range Brings True Competitive PC Gaming to the Couch
summary: TCL's upcoming 2026 TV range aims to redefine couch PC gaming. These new televisions are specifically designed to deliver true competitive gaming performance. They promise to bring advanced PC gaming experiences directly to the living room.

headline: House of the Dragon: Helaena’s Dream Points to Major Fire & Blood Changes
summary: Helaena Targaryen's latest dream sequence suggests significant plot deviations in House of the Dragon. The HBO series appears to be making major changes to George R.R. Martin's Fire & Blood book canon. Fans are speculating on the impact these alterations will have on the story.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3, Episode 7 Recap and Review
summary: A full recap and review is available for House of the Dragon Season 3, Episode 7. The episode prominently features dragons, emphasizing the Targaryen civil war known as the Dance of Dragons. It reminds viewers why the conflict earned its fiery name.

headline: Marvel's Wolverine ESRB Rating Promises 'a Handful of Sequences' Featuring 'Exposed Buttocks'
summary: Marvel's Wolverine has received its official ESRB rating. The rating highlights gore, intense violence, and strong language within the game. It also notes a few sequences featuring a character's 'exposed buttocks.'

headline: Trump suggests new talks with Iran to begin on Monday
summary: Donald Trump has proposed new talks with Iran, suggesting they start on Monday. Tehran has not yet responded to the suggestion that new negotiations are imminent. Previous announcements of a negotiated peace have often been followed by renewed conflict.

headline: Woman has pioneering womb surgery to fix 'miracle' baby with intestines outside its body
summary: Theo, a British baby, underwent pioneering surgery in the womb to correct gastroschisis. He was the first British baby to receive this complex operation. The procedure was part of a groundbreaking clinical trial to address the condition.

headline: Heat health alerts in England as temperatures set to reach 34C
summary: Heat health alerts have been issued across England due to rising temperatures. Some areas are forecast to reach extreme highs of 34C. Residents are advised to take precautions during the ongoing heatwave.

headline: Wales first nation to withdraw support for Infantino
summary: Wales has become the first nation to publicly withdraw its backing for Gianni Infantino's bid to continue leading FIFA. This decision marks a significant stance against the current FIFA president. The move could influence future support for Infantino's leadership.
